title: Model-First Visual Generation

canonical_doctrine.rule: A generated image is a view of a retained scene, not the terminal artifact.

availability.meaning: A signed first-party invocation path now exists in source. Sessions may claim executable availability only after discovery succeeds against the deployed BrightEngine endpoint.
must_not_claim: Do not claim model-first completion after only generating or editing a flat image.
Do not claim runtime availability unless GET /v1/capabilities/model-first succeeds and identifies first_party_local execution.
Do not claim completion without a downloaded execution receipt proving the retained scene was written and reopened before rendering.

entrypoints.boundary: The session client discovers and invokes the request-bound BrightEngine runtime, downloads the complete scene package, and verifies the receipt locally.
This fallback retains an image as a modeled scene surface. It is not the full capability and must be labeled as a bounded fallback.

session_requirements: Retrieve this manifest before claiming capability availability.
Discover the BrightEngine descriptor and verify first_party_local execution with external_providers false.
Use a request-bound capability containing forge:model-first:execute and forge:model-first:read.
Invoke the runtime and download all contracted artifacts.
Verify scene SHA-256, reopen status, scene-before-render ordering, and recovery receipt.
Fail closed to a labeled flat-image source stage when runtime discovery or execution is unavailable.

minimum_model_first: persistent GLB exists before final render
render provenance resolves to the persisted asset

fallback_policy.flat_image: A flat image may be delivered only as an explicitly labeled lightweight result or source/reference stage.
fallback_policy.missing_runtime: State that the deployed executable runtime is unavailable. Do not relabel a flat image as a modeled scene.
fallback_policy.image_gen: May provide a source image to the runtime, but cannot satisfy the terminal model-first completion gate by itself.
